first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ—both directly addressable by simplification. Memory_31 and memory_86 both show that reducing onboarding friction improves completion and adoption. This is a causal lever we've validated before on exactly the population we need to move. Promotional pricing (memory_73) targets the SMB price-sensitive segment but doesn't address the activation decay we're experiencing across the funnel. Activation messaging (memory_91) is secondary to fixing the structural onboarding problem. Referral incentives (memory_57) require an established, healthy activation baseline to work well. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is valuable but doesn't resolve the self-serve activation collapse. Verifying memory_31 and memory_86 directly validates whether signup simplification and onboarding shortening remain effective in current conditions and whether there are seasonal or cohort-specific factors we missed. A standard experiment on simplify_onboarding directly addresses both metrics in decline and preserves the option to run a follow-up experiment on promotional pricing if SMB churn accelerates.

final.rationale: Verified records confirm: memory_31 showed +9% activation and +4% qualified revenue on SMB with only -1% retention risk; memory_86 showed +13% completion, -2.1 day time-to-value, and +3% retention lift. Current situation shows 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline QoQ. Simplify onboarding directly addresses both declines with proven causal precedent and retention upside (not downside). The -1% retention risk on memory_31 is modest against +9% activation gain. This is the highest-leverage move available: it fixes the activation decay, improves completion, and memory_86 shows retention protection. Promotional pricing addresses competitor pressure but not the self-serve funnel collapse. Activation messaging is secondary to fixing the structural onboarding problem. Referral incentives require healthy activation first. Enterprise sales assist doesn't move the self-serve metrics in decline. Standard experiment scope allows measurement of effect durability in current conditions and segment-specific outcomes.
